metric: Population SD, ddof=0, of weighted RGB minus GaussianBlur(1.5) weighted RGB, weights [0.2126,0.7152,0.0722], gamma-encoded RGB on 0-255 scale. Crop first, then calculate high pass.

blur_trial.method: Blur entire reference RGB in memory, then crop same reference patches and compute the stated high-pass metric. No image written.

brightness.recommendation: Do not reduce overall exposure. Different folds and illumination prevent treating these patch means as a global correction target.

implementation_recommendation: Treat static outer-shirt interior only; preserve silhouette alpha and mask-normalize blur to prevent background bleed. Exclude all face/neck and moving RGB. If still needed after blur, a local left reduction capped near 3/255 is a bounded trial.

pre_motion_r8_r9_comparison.hash_binding: Unavailable: reviewer did not capture hashes or mtimes during this earlier review. Do not associate these numbers with subsequently overwritten snapshots.
pre_motion_r8_r9_comparison.visual_finding: R9 improved cloth texture and pale fringe without obvious overblur or new notches. The extension remained sharper than the moving center; faint temple/ear fringe remained. Continuous motion was not assessed.
